Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: 3.8 applied to Ask AI 'yesterday'.

Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S26 A device clock 2 days ahead gives the same 'yesterday' answer (3.8)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Time words in a question ('today', 'yesterday', 'last time') resolve from the server clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock or another time zone gets the same answer as any other device. (UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Hospital patient and NH resident each with prior encounters dated run day −1 and run day −2 (e.g. 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-11 for a 2026-10-13 run), each with one distinct fact

When On a correct-clock device ask "What did the patient say yesterday?"; repeat on a device / browser whose clock is set 2 days ahead

Then Both devices cite the run day −1 encounter and the same fact

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The answers on the two devices name the same encounter and fact (3.8). A difference is a Fail on U10 with both answers quoted

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)
